answer.scene: A multilane urban street approaches a signalized intersection. My car is in the third of four visible lanes traveling in this direction.

right_boundary.observation: A single solid white line separates my lane from the lane occupied by the black sedan; no curb forms this boundary.

lane_markings.observation: A white arrow in my lane has one head pointing straight ahead.
A solid white transverse stop line crosses my lane before the crosswalk.
White longitudinal crosswalk bars cross my lane beyond the stop line.

cross_check.roles: Single solid white lines are consistent with same-direction lane separation on the intersection approach.
cross_check.markings: The straight-only arrow agrees with the lane continuing into the intersection; the stop line and crosswalk do not conflict with it.
cross_check.unseen: No hidden arrow heads, additional words, or waiting areas have been inferred.
